about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Nigerian Egusi Soup with Spinach
recipes.summary: A rich West African soup of ground pumpkin seeds, spinach and chicken simmered in a tomato and chilli base.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, onion and chilli to a smooth puree.
Cook the puree in the oil in a large pot for 10 minutes until it thickens and the oil separates.
Stir the ground pumpkin seeds with 1/2 cup stock to a paste, drop spoonfuls into the pot and cook for 5 minutes until they form soft curds.
Add the chicken, remaining stock and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Fold in the spinach and cook for 3 minutes until wilted.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and keep leftovers refrigerated within 2 hours, reheating until steaming hot.
Serve with rice, fufu or boiled yam.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Groundnut Peanut Soup
recipes.summary: A velvety peanut and tomato soup with chicken and a slow chilli warmth, served with rice balls.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot for 6 minutes until soft, then add the ginger, chilli and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until broken down.
Add the chicken, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Whisk the peanut butter with a ladle of hot broth until smooth and stir it back into the pot.
Simmer gently for 10 minutes until the soup thickens and a slick of oil rises to the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Use natural peanut butter with no added sugar.
Contains peanuts.

recipes.title: Nigerian Ofada Style Pepper Stew
recipes.summary: A smoky, deep red stew of roasted capsicum and chilli, cooked down in oil with onion and locust-free spices.
steps: Char the capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes until blistered and blackened, then peel and deseed.
Blend with the chillies and 1 onion to a coarse puree.
Cook the remaining diced onion in the oil in a pot for 5 minutes until soft, then add the tomato paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the puree and cook for 20 minutes, stirring, until the sauce darkens and the oil separates.
Add the beef, stock and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the beef is tender.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and at least 75°C and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Traditionally eaten with rice and boiled egg.

recipes.title: West African Party Jollof Rice
recipes.summary: Long-grain rice cooked in a smoky tomato and capsicum sauce until every grain is red and fluffy.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, capsicum, half the onion and the chilli, then simmer the puree for 15 minutes until reduced by half.
Cook the remaining onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the tomato paste, curry powder and thyme for 2 minutes.
Add the reduced puree, stock, salt and rinsed rice, stir once, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
notes: Food safety: cool and refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Use vegetable stock for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Fried Plantain with Pepper Sauce
recipes.summary: Ripe plantain slices fried until caramelised, served with a quick tomato and chilli sauce.
steps: Cook the onion in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until soft, then add the tomatoes, chilli and salt and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Heat the 1/3 cup oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the plantain for 3 minutes each side until deep golden.
Drain on paper towel and serve with the sauce.
notes: Use plantains that are mostly yellow with black spots for the sweetest result.

recipes.title: Jamaican Steamed Cabbage with Carrot
recipes.summary: Quick-steamed cabbage with thyme, garlic and a touch of chilli, a staple Jamaican side.
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil in a large pan for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the cabbage, carrot, thyme, salt and water, cover and steam for 6 minutes until the cabbage is tender but still bright.
Uncover and toss for 2 minutes until the liquid evaporates.
notes: Serve with rice and peas or jerk chicken.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Callaloo Style Spinach Side
recipes.summary: Silky wilted spinach with coconut milk, okra and thyme, in the style of Trinidad's Sunday callaloo.
steps: Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the spinach, okra, coconut milk, water, thyme, chilli and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the okra is tender.
Remove the chilli and blend with a stick blender until smooth.
notes: Use oil instead of butter for vegan.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Tostones with Garlic Mojo
recipes.summary: Twice-fried green plantain discs with a hot garlic and lime dipping oil.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into 3 cm chunks.
Fry in the vegetable oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until pale gold, then lift out and press flat with a plate.
Return to the oil and fry for 2 minutes each side until crisp and deep golden, then drain and sprinkle with salt.
Warm the olive oil with the garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant, then stir in the lime juice and coriander and serve for dipping.
notes: Serve while hot and crisp.

recipes.title: Bajan Cou-Cou Cornmeal and Okra
recipes.summary: A smooth, golden cornmeal and okra pudding from Barbados, stirred until it pulls away from the pot.
steps: Boil the okra in the water with the salt for 8 minutes until tender, then lift out and set aside, keeping the water.
Mix the cornmeal with 1/2 cup cold water, whisk into the hot okra water and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes until very thick.
Fold in the okra and beat in the butter until the mixture pulls away from the pot.
Shape into a smooth dome with a wet spoon and serve.
notes: Traditionally served with flying fish or a spicy stew.
Use oil instead of butter for vegan.

recipes.title: Dominican Habichuelas Guisadas Stewed Beans
recipes.summary: Butter beans simmered with pumpkin, sofrito and oregano into a thick, savoury stew.
steps: Cook the onion, capsicum and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and oregano for 1 minute, then add the beans, pumpkin, water and salt.
Simmer for 25 minutes, mashing some of the pumpkin into the sauce, until the beans are creamy and thick.
Stir in the coriander and serve over rice.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and tastes better the next day.

recipes.title: Pork Dumplings in Ginger Broth
recipes.summary: Plump pork and chive dumplings floating in a light ginger broth with bok choy.
steps: Mix the pork, chives, soy sauce, sesame oil and half the ginger until sticky.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edge, fold and press closed.
Simmer the stock with the remaining ginger and vinegar for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Drop in the dumplings and cook for 5 minutes until they float and the pork is cooked through, adding the bok choy for the last 2 minutes until tender.
Ladle into bowls and scatter with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the dumplings until the filling reaches 75°C and eat within 1 day if stored.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pelmeni in Chicken Broth
recipes.summary: Small Russian meat dumplings served in a clear dill-scented chicken broth.
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt for 5 minutes until a smooth dough forms, then cover and rest.
Mix the beef, onion, salt and pepper, roll the dough thin and cut 5 cm rounds.
Place a small ball of filling in each round, fold and press the edges, then pinch the corners together.
Simmer the stock, drop in the pelmeni and cook for 7 minutes until they float and the beef is cooked through.
Serve with dill and sour cream.
notes: Food safety: cook until the filling reaches 75°C. Freeze uncooked pelmeni on a tray, then bag.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tibetan Momo Thukpa Soup
recipes.summary: Beef momo dumplings in a warming ginger, tomato and vegetable broth.
steps: Mix the beef, spring onion, half the ginger, half the garlic and soy sauce until sticky.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edge and pleat closed.
Simmer the stock with the tomatoes, carrot, cumin and remaining ginger and garlic for 10 minutes until the carrot is tender.
Add the cabbage and momos and cook for 6 minutes until the momos float and the beef is cooked through.
Serve scattered with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the momos until the filling reaches 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Warm Lentil Salad with Goats Cheese
recipes.summary: Peppery rocket and warm green lentils with roasted red onion and crumbled goat's cheese.
steps: Roast the onion wedges with 1 tbsp of the oil at 200°C for 25 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender but still holding their shape, then drain.
Whisk the remaining oil, vinegar, mustard and salt and toss through the warm lentils.
Fold in the onions and rocket and crumble the goat's cheese over the top.
notes: Serve warm for the best flavour.

recipes.title: Warm Kale and Roasted Pumpkin Salad
recipes.summary: Tender kale, caramelised pumpkin, toasted pepitas and a maple mustard dressing.
steps: Roast the pumpkin with 1 tbsp of the oil at 220°C for 25 minutes until golden and soft.
Whisk the remaining oil, maple syrup, vinegar, mustard and salt together.
Massage the kale with half the dressing for 2 minutes until it softens and darkens.
Toss with the warm pumpkin and toasted pepitas, then crumble over the feta and drizzle with the remaining dressing.
notes: Leave out the feta for vegan.

recipes.title: Warm Mushroom and Spinach Salad with Thyme
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried mushrooms tossed through baby spinach with a warm garlic and balsamic dressing.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in 2 tbsp oil in a hot pan for 6 minutes until golden and their liquid has evaporated.
Add the garlic, thyme and salt and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the balsamic vinegar and remaining oil and stir for 30 seconds until sizzling.
Pour over the spinach, toss until just wilted and top with walnuts.
notes: Do not crowd the pan or the mushrooms will steam instead of browning.

recipes.title: Warm Cabbage and Apple Salad with Bacon
recipes.summary: Sweet-sour sauteed cabbage and crisp apple with smoky bacon and a hot cider dressing.
steps: Cook the bacon in a large pan for 5 minutes until crisp, then add the onion and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the cabbage and cook for 5 minutes until just wilted but still crunchy.
Stir in the vinegar, honey and mustard until the dressing bubbles, then toss through the apples and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Leave out the bacon and use smoked paprika for vegetarian.
